title: V8 Engine Laboratory
description: Eight cylinders. One synchronized machine. Slice through a working cross-plane V8 and follow the motion from ignition to crankshaft.
imageAlt: Illustrated cutaway V8 engine with exposed pistons and crankshaft, metallic finishes and dramatic studio lighting
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & mobile · Idealized teaching model · Illustrated cover

title: Cyberdyne Systems · SKYNET
description: Chrome armor. A glowing neural core. Explore an animated Cyberdyne Systems sculpture with mechanical rings, cinematic lighting, and a living network of signals.
imageAlt: Chrome and red Cyberdyne Systems Skynet concept artwork that inspired the interactive sculpture
note: Desktop & mobile · Interactive sculpture · Preview shows concept artwork

title: Fluid Lab
description: Stir color into motion. Paint flowing dye, build swirling currents, and explore a real-time fluid simulation with hands-on controls.
imageAlt: Illustrated cyan, violet and pink currents swirling across a dark background
note: WebGL · Desktop & mobile · Interactive fluid sandbox

title: Philadelphia Relief Diorama
description: The Delaware Valley, in miniature. Explore wooded ridges and two rivers, then zoom seamlessly into photographic 3D buildings and streets. One map, from regional relief to neighborhood detail.
imageAlt: The live Philadelphia Relief diorama: wooded terrain, rivers and a raised cutaway base on a light backdrop
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & mobile · Real elevation and Google photographic 3D via Cesium · Imagery streams on approach

title: Defender, Robotron & Joust — Inside the Arcade
description: Explore three arcade cabinets after closing. Click Defender, Robotron or Joust to bring it forward, separate its assemblies, trace the circuits and watch autonomous battles with original sprites and sounds.
imageAlt: Live exploded Defender exhibit with a detailed cabinet and autonomous space battle on its CRT
note: WebGL · Desktop & mobile · Interpretive model · Preview captured from the live exhibit

title: The Living Aquascape
description: Explore a planted aquarium in 3D: orbit the glass tank, follow a school of cardinal tetras and watch flowing plants and rippling water. Switch to the photographic aquarium to explore its ecosystem, circulation and leaf details.
imageAlt: Actual 3D aquarium with a tetra school, branching driftwood, red and green plants, and a winding sand path
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & touch · Switch views inside the aquarium

title: Model S Studio
description: Explore a silver Model S Plaid in 308 selectable pieces, then take the driver’s seat. Take a guided tour, inspect four interior close-ups, try the interactive display and discover the schematic battery anatomy.
imageAlt: Actual Model S Studio showing a silver Tesla Model S Plaid with separated body panels, glass, wheels, cabin surfaces and an added schematic battery
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & mobile · Artist model by 3D Hawk, CC BY 4.0 · Preview captured from the running demo

title: Anatomy Studio
description: Explode a complete human body into 2,270 named anatomical pieces across ten systems, then open seventeen nested exploded views, from the heart, lungs, spine and brain to the skull, eye, hand, knee, rib cage, digestive tract, urinary system, face, aorta, pelvis, shoulder, larynx and foot. Skin, X-ray, realistic, colour-coded and clay finishes with ambient occlusion, and detail that sharpens as you zoom; every piece described.
imageAlt: Actual Anatomy Studio showing a human body mid-explosion: translucent skin regions and muscles fanned outward from the skeleton, with organs, vessels and nerves separated in layers
features: Seventeen nested explodes: heart to foot
Skin, X-ray, realistic, organs-only, colour-coded & clay finishes
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop first, phones load the core systems · Z-Anatomy model, CC BY-SA 4.0 · Preview captured from the running demo

title: H2D Explorer
description: Explore 44 reconstructed Bambu Lab H2D assemblies, then watch four original models print layer by layer. Reveal infill and supports, follow the nozzle, and inspect each finished object.
imageAlt: Actual H2D Explorer showing the reconstructed enclosed printer, glass door, motion system and build platform
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & mobile · Original educational reconstruction, not factory CAD

title: Koi Pond Garden
description: A quiet Japanese garden brought to life. Feed colourful koi, explore above and below the water, and drift through changing weather and seasons. Created by Sourany Phomhome (Sourany Studio).
imageAlt: Koi swimming in the original project’s Japanese garden pond, surrounded by rocks and plants
note: WebGL · Best on desktop · By Sourany Phomhome · Preview supplied by the original project

title: Open Sea
description: A real-time WebGL 2 ocean with five spectral wave cascades and a detailed 52 m, three-masted schooner. Sail from glassy calm into a storm, through sunset, moonlight, rain and lightning, then dive into blue water with light shafts and independently swimming fish. A slow cinematic tour hands over to free flight, with a visible fullscreen control.
imageAlt: A detailed navy-hulled three-masted schooner sailing across a blue simulated ocean
features: Sea states from glassy calm to storm
Sunrise to moonlit night, clouds that shadow the water
Rain, lightning and a detailed schooner with a wake
Underwater view with light shafts and fish
note: WebGL 2 · Best on a desktop GPU · Drag or use movement keys to take over · H hides the controls

title: APX-9 · Pollination Engineering
description: A small machine. A brighter tomorrow. Explore 502 named components inside a mechanical bumblebee: layered yellow armor and fur, compound optics, smart-glass wings, geared flight drives, six articulated legs, power cells and a pollen-handling system.
imageAlt: Actual APX-9 3D exhibit: densely furred yellow-and-black mechanical bumblebee with dark compound eyes, metallic joints, six articulated legs and gold-veined transparent wings
note: WebGL 2 · Best on a desktop GPU · Touch supported · Original concept reconstruction · Preview captured from the running exhibit

title: Point Lookout — North Stradbroke Island
description: Take in the Queensland coast from a windswept headland. Watch rolling ocean swells, foaming breakers and sea spray beneath drifting clouds, with moving coastal vegetation and a procedural surf-and-wind soundscape.
imageAlt: Actual Point Lookout demo showing blue ocean, foaming surf, a curving beach and windswept headland vegetation
note: WebGL 2 · Best on a desktop GPU · Tap or press Enter after loading · Original: claude-creative-xbmc.vercel.app

title: The Clockwork Garden
description: A forgotten Victorian glasshouse of brass and porcelain, and APX-9, the mechanical bee that tends it. Watch the 58-second film of the garden waking, fly as APX-9 to pollinate blooms, wind the escapement and grow the garden, or follow the bee as it goes about its day.
imageAlt: Actual Clockwork Garden frame: the yellow-and-black APX-9 mechanical bee with gold-veined glass wings beside an open porcelain flower with glowing brass stamens
features: Fly as APX-9 · pollinate & grow the garden
Time of day, photo mode & procedural sound
note: WebGL 2 · Best on a desktop GPU · Touch supported · Sound stays off until you turn it on · Preview captured from the running piece

title: Mechanical Flower: Exploded View
description: A jeweled-enamel clockwork flower that assembles and comes apart on a 28-second loop. Watch twelve enamel petals, the stamen cage and glowing core, the filigree gear ring, drive gears, braided stem, retention collars and leaf panels fly out to match a ten-callout engineering infographic, then close back into a blooming flower on a dark studio backdrop. Drag the Explode and Bloom sliders to scrub it by hand.
imageAlt: Actual Mechanical Flower demo: on the left the exploded view with enamel petals, brass stamen cage, glowing core and gear ring floating apart on parchment; on the right the assembled flower in bloom on a dark backdrop
features: Ten labelled parts, 84 floating gold screws
Scrub Explode and Bloom by hand
Flashing jewel glints and drifting sparks
note: WebGL 2 · Best on a desktop GPU · Touch supported · Built by an iterating render-and-review loop; a strict independent reviewer scored it 3.8 out of 5 against the photo, short of the 4.5 target: a close match in layout and palette, not an exact one · Preview captured from the running demo

title: Coastal Village · Beach Diorama
description: A sunlit village beside turquoise water. Explore the beach, colorful houses, stone quay and little rowboat from Pavel’s coastal rendering demo.
imageAlt: Colorful coastal houses, a bell tower and a rowboat beside a turquoise-water cutaway diorama
note: WebGPU-capable desktop browser · First visit prepares lighting and may take a few minutes

title: Fire Pro
description: Shape a campfire, unleash a flamethrower or stir a fire tornado. Dan Greenheck’s real-time volumetric fire editor brings swirling flames, smoke and explosions to your browser.
imageAlt: Campfire with bright orange flames, glowing logs and rolling smoke, supplied by the Fire Pro project
note: Requires WebGPU · Best on a recent desktop GPU · Preview supplied by the original project

title: Weatherglass
description: A tiny living world under glass. Grab clouds and squeeze out rain, brush mist across the valley, stir the wind, and turn a sunlit spring landscape into winter.
imageAlt: Actual Weatherglass scene: mountains, trees, a waterfall and a blue lake inside a brass-framed glass terrarium
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & touch controls · Preview captured from the running demo

title: Weatherglass Terrarium
description: A photoreal rainforest under glass with a living bearded dragon. It roams the whole case, wades, basks, drinks and hunts crickets while you squeeze clouds into rain, shake them into thunderstorms, stir the wind, pour fog and ripple the pool.
imageAlt: Actual Weatherglass Terrarium scene: a bearded dragon on driftwood beside mossy basalt peaks with bromeliads, a waterfall into a pool, dense ferns and clouds inside a brass-framed glass case
note: WebGL 2 · Best on desktop GPUs · Preview captured from the running demo
